A row of large angular dark ochre-brown dorsal fur spines runs from the shoulders along the back, decreasing toward the rump. Four short white clawed canine paws, rounded strong hind haunches, and one long bushy white curved drooping tail with an ochre spot. No collar, saddle, weapon or armor.
